headline: Gifts for people that you like. But only a little.
intro: Want to send someone a thoughtful gift, but think they should have to work for it? You're in the right place.
about: Make Your Own Crap sells make-it-yourself gift kits. The recipient gets something genuinely nice — they just have to build the thing themselves before they can enjoy it. It comes from the creators of Make Your Own Damn Candle, which applied the same idea to candles: a real product, a real result, and a small amount of suffering in between.
